theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_lc_sd_level_decomposition
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (R A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (B S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (ρ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (β : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (W₀ : Set (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), ρ.Represents R → IsIntegerMultiplicity S' → Continuous f → IsOpen W₀ → IsCompact {x | f x ≤ t} → {x | f x ≤ t} ⊆ W₀ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ρ.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 2)) x) ∂ρ.measure) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, β.orient x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂β.measure) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) {x | f x = t} → A.boundary η = B η) → (A.boundary - B).massOn W₀ ≤ c → c ≠ ∞ → (∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W univ → T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T.boundary) → ∃ Y Sr : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = 0 ∧ Y.support ⊆ {x | f x ≤ t} ∧ Sr.mass ≤ S'.massOn W₀ + c ∧ (∀ Q : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Q.Represents Y → Q.measure {x | f x = t} ≤ c) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ {x | f x < t} → Y ω = R.boundary ω ∧ Sr ω = S' ω
